summary: Round 3 (final) review of bf0f93a9. PRR-05 is fixed. execute() writes accepted.json only after the adapter exits 0 and validate_result passes; it stores the result.json SHA256 and the evidence object with per-file digests. summarize() requires accepted.json, checks that result.json still matches its recorded hash, checks that the evidence object is identical, and then calls validate_result again, which rehashes each evidence file. Editing a result or evidence file after acceptance therefore fails unless accepted.json is rewritten in the same coordinated edit. The docs disclaim that case and require read-only archives. The new test edits loop_seconds after acceptance and expects 'accepted result changed'. The controller has 20 tests, which matches the coordinator's 20/20 claim. The gates are unchanged from round 2: freeze/identity checks, the phase and allocation gates, the balanced AB/BA schedule, A/A run on baseline only, T95 indexing, the receipt-per-flag rule and the all-false profile flags. The merged docs/performance/README.md keeps the PR319 Sim10 entry and the template paragraph as separate items; the template paragraph claims no performance result. integration.json is internally consistent: the merge was recorded with the 19-test controller, before the PRR-05 commit. The run51 numbers check out: 16,777,216 - 8,825 = 16,768,391 good pixels, which is 99.9474%; 3x32x512x1024 elements x 8 bytes = 402,653,184 bytes. The audit stays limited to pixel_status and does not claim permanence. One optional low finding (PRR-06): the existing placement-edit test now stops at the earlier hash gate, so the within-case placement check is no longer tested directly. Nothing blocks.

findings.evidence: Resolved. execute writes accepted.json with result_sha256 and evidence after validation (lines 264-265). summarize enforces it (lines 307-310). test_accepted_timing_change_rejected (test_campaign.py:195-200) covers editing loop_seconds after acceptance. The docs state the remaining limit: a coordinated rewrite of all receipts is not detected.

test_placement_drift_rejected edits result.json after acceptance, so it now fails at the 'accepted result changed' hash gate (line 121). The within-case check 'CPU/GPU placement changed within case' (campaign.py:315-316) is no longer reached by any test. The cross-phase test (lines 129-138) changes the node for every sample, so it trips 'placement changed since correctness' rather than the within-case check.
